title: SAFE-Mem: Secure Agentic Memory with Fine-Grained Authority and Governance-Aware Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.22959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to support long-term reasoning and personalized interactions. However, information collected from external sources can introduce security risks when untrusted claims (i.e., atomic statements) are later treated as authorized preferences, policies, or permissions. Existing defenses typically rely on content-based filtering or coarse-grained provenance tracking, which either fail to prevent unauthorized memory use or block legitimate information, sacrificing memory utility. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE-Mem, a fine-grained memory governance framework that improves security while preserving legitimate memory use. First, SAFE-Mem annotates each claim with three governance labels (i.e., kind, authority, and scope) to capture its provenance and permitted use. translated_title: SAFE-Mem：具有细粒度权限与治理感知检索的安全智能体记忆
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖持久化记忆来支持长期推理与个性化交互。然而，当从外部来源收集的不可信声明（即原子性陈述）随后被当作经授权的偏好、策略或权限使用时，这些信息可能带来安全风险。现有的防御手段通常依赖于基于内容的过滤或粗粒度的来源追踪，它们要么无法阻止未经授权的记忆使用，要么会屏蔽合法信息，从而牺牲了记忆的效用。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了SAFE-Mem，这是一种细粒度的记忆治理框架，能够在保留合法记忆使用的同时提升安全性。首先，SAFE-Mem为每条声明标注三种治理标签（即类型、权限和范围），以捕获其来源和允许的使用方式。其次，治理感知检索将查询需求与声明权限相匹配，以阻止未经授权的记忆使用（原文摘要到此中断）。
tldr: 提出SAFE-Mem框架，通过为记忆声明标注细粒度治理标签并结合治理感知检索，在保障LLM智能体记忆安全性的同时保留合法的记忆使用。
en_tdlr: SAFE-Mem, a fine-grained memory governance framework that annotates memory claims with governance labels and employs governance-aware retrieval to enhance the security of LLM agent memory while preserving legitimate memory use.
